sources.claim: U(1)-invariant projectable F(R)-HL Hamiltonian analysis; special F(x)=x has Hamiltonian structure coinciding with non-relativistic covariant HL/HMT; identifies Phi_1^II and Phi_2^II as second-class and states their bracket is nonzero.
Hamiltonian analysis of non-relativistic covariant Hořava-Lifshitz gravity with first- and second-class constraints and correct physical degree count.
